arguments.message: Sure! On our status page you’ll see a **Subscribe** button. Clicking it lets you choose how you’d like to receive incident notifications – via email, SMS, or a webhook. You can also limit the subscription to specific components so you only get alerts for the parts of the platform you care about. Once you subscribe, you’ll get a notification the moment an incident is opened, updated, or resolved.
